assets.role: Boot ROM a machine runs instead of Apple's AVPBooter.vresearch1.bin.
assets.build: make build/OpenAVB.bin with Homebrew LLVM 23.1.3 (clang, llvm-objcopy) and LLD 23.1.3; no patches. Built by the vphone-cli maintainers; not independently rebuilt here.
assets.license: MIT, with the third-party notices in its LICENSE; some files built into the image are APSL-2.0

assets.role: SEP boot ROM a machine runs instead of Apple's AVPSEPBooter.vresearch1.bin.
assets.build: make PLATFORM=vresearch1 build/OpenSEP.bin with Homebrew LLVM 23.1.3 and LLD 23.1.3; no patches. Built by the vphone-cli maintainers; not independently rebuilt here.
assets.license: MIT; the image also carries public Apple data (the Apple DDI Secure Boot Root CA - G1 certificate and published iPhone14,4 SEP firmware keys)

assets.role: Metal shader compiler plugin (libAppleParavirtCompilerPluginIOGPUFamily.dylib) the cloudOS 23E5207q GPU bundle lacks; without it MTLCompilerService aborts and the window stays black.
assets.build: xcrun --sdk iphoneos clang++ -arch arm64e -miphoneos-version-min=26.1 -std=c++17 -O2 -dynamiclib -Wl,-not_for_dyld_shared_cache with dynamic lookup of the LLVM symbols; ad hoc signed. The built digest is recorded in the guest payload receipt.
assets.license: Unverified: the origin repository declares no licence; vphone-cli redistributes the file under its MIT licence. Redistribution terms need a decision before a built plugin is shipped.

assets.role: launchdhook-vphone.dylib, loaded into launchd by the guest environment; inserts SystemHook at spawn and carries the ARM64E_X1 on-demand instruction lowering.
assets.build: xcrun --sdk iphoneos clang -arch arm64e -miphoneos-version-min=26.0 -Os -dynamiclib, with MIG-generated mach_exc stubs from the macOS SDK; ad hoc signed. See VPhoneGuestComponents/Makefile at the pinned revision.
assets.notes: Upstream installs it through the boot-tier system-launchdaemons-boot-environment patch. Whether the first release needs it, including the X1 lowering on this host CPU, is established by FW-08 and E2E-02.

assets.role: SystemHook-vphone.dylib, inserted at spawn; loads the per-process fixes such as libhapticsfix into SpringBoard. Links FlutterRemapFix.
assets.build: xcrun --sdk iphoneos clang -arch arm64e -miphoneos-version-min=26.0 -Os -dynamiclib -Wl,-not_for_dyld_shared_cache; ad hoc signed.
assets.notes: Required only if a first-release fix it loads is required; established by FW-08 and E2E-02.

assets.role: libhapticsfix.dylib, loaded into SpringBoard so UIKit's feedback engine takes the no-haptics path instead of crashing on the absent haptic hardware.
assets.build: xcrun --sdk iphoneos clang -arch arm64e -miphoneos-version-min=26.0 -Os -dynamiclib -lobjc -Wl,-not_for_dyld_shared_cache; ad hoc signed.
assets.notes: The standard device tree also removes the haptics node; whether both are needed is established by E2E-02.

assets.role: AppleParavirtGPUMetalIOGPUFamily.bundle, the paravirtual GPU driver the iPhone guest display needs, taken from the same cloudOS release as the kernel.
assets.build: Extracted by FW-05 from the restored, read-only mounted System volume of a temporary cloudOS restore; digests recorded at extraction.
assets.license: Apple proprietary firmware content; never committed or redistributed

assets.role: iPhone restore IPSW supplying the guest userland and iPhone components of the hybrid restore.
assets.build: Acquired by FW-02 into the IPSW cache; identity from its BuildManifest and digest verified before use. Originals stay immutable.
assets.license: Apple proprietary firmware; never committed or redistributed
